paper_title: New Constraints on ALP Electron and Photon Couplings from ArgoNeuT and the MiniBooNE Beam Dump
notes: Paper constrains both ALP-photon (gaγ) and ALP-electron (gae) couplings from MiniBooNE dump-mode data and ArgoNeuT projections. Pre-analysis hint of AxionElectron is plausible since both are presented; I report the gae limit (Fig. 8) as the chosen coupling. Data points are approximate readings of the MiniBooNE 2σ exclusion contour from Fig. 8 (no numerical table provided); values are rough estimates from the described contour features (e.g. resonant peak near ma~10-16 MeV reaching gae~3e-8). The gaγ result (Fig. 7) would be AxionPhoton at GeV^-1.
